name: Solar Voyager: Explore the Solar System
summary:
**Your ship. The real Solar System.**

Solar Voyager is a VR solar system explorer and planetarium in one. Take the pilot seat of a starship with the whole Solar System outside the canopy, laid out as it really is: planets and moons in their true places for today's date, or any date you choose.

**Fly it with your hands**
The cockpit is built from physical controls. Grip the thrust lever, turn the flight-mode knob, set the autopilot ring, push the cruise lever and cross space at many times the speed of ligh
